full_judgment: Bimalendu Bikash Roy Chowdhury J: Leave to appeal has been sought by the plaintiff against the order of remand dated 25 May 1977 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.2654 of 1996 which arose out of a suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in respect of 1.05 acre of land comprised within SA Plot Nos.2086 and 2087 of Mouza Singair filed before a Subordinate Judge, Manikganj.
